database.pythonRequired: [SXMY] Notice: Python is required for database/file modes (https://www.python.org/downloads/)

help.descConfig: Switch configuration items and hot reload

config.defaultTemplate:
# SXMY_Plugin config file
# Changes take effect after server restart

[general]
# Server-wide language: zh / en
Language = "zh"

[WelcomeMsg]
# Plugin switch
enable = true
# Delay in seconds before sending the welcome message
delay = 5
# Welcome message sent via private message, <\n> for new line (sent as multiple messages)
text = "Welcome to SXMY server<\n>Enjoy"

[DataBase]
# Database module switch
enable = false
# Database address: domain/ipv4:port
address = false
# Database name
BaseName = ""
# Database user
BaseUser = ""
# Database password
Basepwd = ""
config.usageValueHint: [SXMY] <value> Use SXMY Config <item> to query available values
config.usageWmDelay:
[SXMY] Usage: SXMY Config WelcomeMsg-delay <x> <y(reload)/n(no reload)>
[SXMY] <x> number >= 0
config.usageWmText:
[SXMY] Usage: SXMY Config WelcomeMsg-text "<text>" <y(reload)/n(no reload)>
[SXMY] <text> any text (must be quoted)
config.usageDbAddress:
[SXMY] Usage: SXMY Config DataBase-address "<address>" <y(reload)/n(no reload)>
[SXMY] <address> domain/ipv4:port
config.usageDbBaseName:
[SXMY] Usage: SXMY Config DataBase-BaseName "<name>" <y(reload)/n(no reload)>
[SXMY] <name> database name
config.usageDbBaseUser:
[SXMY] Usage: SXMY Config DataBase-BaseUser "<user>" <y(reload)/n(no reload)>
[SXMY] <user> database user (empty defaults to root)
config.usageDbBasepwd:
[SXMY] Usage: SXMY Config DataBase-Basepwd "<pwd>" <y(reload)/n(no reload)>
[SXMY] <pwd> database password
config.quotedRequired: [SXMY] Invalid value: {1} must be wrapped in quotes, e.g. SXMY Config WelcomeMsg-text "text"

reload.usage: [SXMY] Usage: SXMY Reload <feature(optional, empty reloads all)>
